d: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, owners of a haunted theatre in Woonsocket, Rhode Island buy the building next door and activity spikes!   TAPS investigates both buildings to see if spirits are traveling between the two locations.

d: The final day has arrived –it's Grant's last investigation with TAPS.   And where better to close out his phenomenal run but at Jason and Grant's very own haunted property, Spalding Inn, located in Whitefield, New Hampshire.

t: Ghost Hunters: There Ghosts The Neighborhood
d: TAPSis called out to Joplin, Missouri to help 3 generations of afamilyliving on one haunted estate!    Could both houses on the property harbor entities that couldbring harm to their children?

st: Too Many Apparitions in the Kitchen
d: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the Culinary Institute of America in Hyde Park, New Yorkcalls in TAPS to find out if the spirits of Jesuit priests still roam the areas where they once lived, worked and were buried when it was a seminary.

On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murder, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell?

On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate a mansion with a dark history involving an ill-fated and secret love story that ended with a woman committing suicide.
We pick were we last left off, in Hawaii, for the reveal.  Jason and Grant were called back for a very important personal case, the Reid House, in Rhode Island, to help a scared 4 year old.

On this episode TAPS heads back to the fan favorite; Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, an abandoned tuberculosis hospital haunted by its former patients and staff.

d: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor.
